Name: Elegant Craftables
Author: collingbe
Description:
[size=4]Update :[/size]
[size=3]1.0.4 : adds 1.6 new craftables[/size]
[size=3]1.0.3 : adds new decorations
1.0.2 : changed a few assets, changes approved by [url=https://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235][b][color=#ffff00]글화[/color][/b][/url][/size]
[size=3]1.0.1 : now you can enable/disable each individual craftables/decorations.[/size]



Finally, a collection of elegant craftables and decorations with a hint of fantasy.

[size=4][color=#ffff00]NOTE that Content Patcher Animations is not a hard dependency, but highly recommended[/color]
[/size][size=3]this mod will still show in game even if you do not have [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url][size=3] installed, but it will not show the animations. If you do not like the animations you can disable it using [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3] or manually change the config.json file. Preview of the animations is shown in the Images tab.[/size]
[size=4]
[color=#ff0000]ALSO NOTE [/color]that the crab pot may look weird submerged in water, especially if you are using a darker map recolor mod. You can disable it in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if it bothers you or if you wish to use another crab pot mod.
